## Services
- Technical SEO: audits, crawlability, indexing, site speed, schema, Core Web Vitals

- GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): getting brands cited in ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity answers
- AEO (Answer Engine Optimization): featured snippets, People Also Ask, voice answers
- Platform SEO: Shopify and Wix
